title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
title_zh: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求
title_primary: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求
title_secondary: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
authors: Anusha Chari, Gian Maria Milesi-Ferretti
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了外国对美国资产的需求，尤其侧重于美国国债。本文记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别之间的构成变化，并提供了更接近基于国籍概念的债权人头寸估计。尽管美国股票价格上涨解释了净外部头寸恶化的相当大一部分，但外国对美国国债的购买一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。过去十年中，外国官方投资者持有这些证券的份额大幅下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额则有所上升。外国官方持有量的下降可由储备积累减少、美联储持有量增加以及美元相对于其他储备货币升值得到很好的解释。这些证据与各国央行调整其投资组合以避免货币份额大幅波动的行为相一致。地缘经济碎片化与对美国国债的官方需求呈负相关，而外国私人需求则仍然对避险动态保持敏感。总体而言，本文评估了这些结构性变化如何影响对美国资产的投资组合偏好，以及它们在地缘政治和财政不确定性加剧之际对美国外部头寸的潜在影响。

title: How currency hedging moves exchange rates
title_zh: 货币对冲如何影响汇率
title_primary: 货币对冲如何影响汇率
title_secondary: How currency hedging moves exchange rates
authors: Leonie Bräuer, Harald Hau
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Foreign investors’ growing holdings of dollar-denominated bonds have created a large demand to hedge dollar risk. Using outstanding FX forward and swap positions for seven major dollar currency pairs, this column shows that changes in fund hedging are closely tied to exchange rate movements. Dealer banks transmit derivative demand to the spot market, while investors’ tendency to hedge less after the dollar appreciates can amplify currency movements.
abstract_zh: 外国投资者持有美元计价债券的规模不断增长，产生了对冲美元风险的大量需求。本文利用七大主要美元货币对的未平仓外汇远期和掉期头寸，指出基金对冲行为的变化与汇率变动密切相关。交易商银行将衍生品需求传导至即期市场，而投资者在美元升值后倾向于减少对冲，这一行为可能放大货币波动。

title: Natural Experiments in Macroeconomics
title_zh: 宏观经济中的自然实验
title_primary: 宏观经济中的自然实验
title_secondary: Natural Experiments in Macroeconomics
authors: Nicola Fuchs-Schündeln, Tarek Hassan
official: 官方在线 2015-05-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A growing literature relies on natural experiments to establish causal effects in macroeconomics. In diverse applications, natural experiments have been used to verify underlying assumptions of conventional models, quantify specific model parameters, and identify mechanisms that have major effects on macroeconomic quantities but are absent from conventional models. We discuss and compare the use of natural experiments across these different applications and summarize what they have taught us about such diverse subjects as the validity of the Permanent Income Hypothesis, the size of the fiscal multiplier, and about the effects of institutions, social structure, and culture on economic growth. We also outline challenges for future work in each of these fields, give guidance for identifying useful natural experiments, and discuss the strengths and weaknesses of the approach.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献依赖于自然实验来确立宏观经济学中的因果效应。在多样化的应用中，自然实验已被用于验证传统模型的基本假设、量化特定模型参数，并识别那些对宏观经济量有重大影响但在传统模型中缺失的机制。我们讨论并比较了自然实验在这些不同应用中的使用情况，总结了它们如何增进了我们对诸如永久收入假说的有效性、财政乘数的大小，以及制度、社会结构和文化对经济增长影响等多样主题的理解。我们还概述了这些领域未来工作面临的挑战，为识别有用的自然实验提供指导，并讨论了该方法的优势与局限。

title: More Frequent Than You Think: Revisiting Capital Structure Adjustment
title_zh: 比你想象的更频繁：资本结构调整再探
title_primary: 比你想象的更频繁：资本结构调整再探
title_secondary: More Frequent Than You Think: Revisiting Capital Structure Adjustment
authors: Zhiguo He, Peter M. DeMarzo, Qiping Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper revisits the empirical evidence on capital structure adjustment and the prevalence of financing “inaction.” We show that the conclusion of infrequent leverage adjustment is sensitive to two methodological choices: high adjustment thresholds and reliance on net balance-sheet changes. Using lower thresholds and gross flows from cash-flow statements, we find adjustment is far more frequent than previously documented, and the pattern reveals pronounced size-based heterogeneity. Smaller firms exhibit considerable inertia consistent with fixed costs; the largest firms (e.g., top 1% by assets) behave as if frictions are negligible. Frictionless recapitalization models thus better describe large-firm leverage dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了关于资本结构调整及融资“不作为”普遍性的实证证据。我们表明，杠杆调整不频繁的结论对两种方法论选择敏感：高调整阈值及依赖净资产负债表变动。采用较低阈值及现金流量表中的总流量，我们发现调整频率远高于先前文献所记载，且该模式揭示了显著的基于规模的异质性。较小企业表现出与固定成本相符的显著惯性；最大型企业（如按资产计前1%）则表现得仿佛摩擦可忽略不计。因此，无摩擦再资本化模型更能描述大型企业的杠杆动态。

title: Model averaging for time–varying vector autoregressions
title_zh: 时变向量自回归的模型平均
title_primary: 时变向量自回归的模型平均
title_secondary: Model averaging for time–varying vector autoregressions
authors: Yuying Sun, Feng Chen, Jiti Gao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a novel time-varying model averaging (TVMA) approach to enhancing forecast accuracy for multivariate time series subject to structural changes. The TVMA method averages predictions from a set of time-varying vector autoregressive models using optimal time-varying combination weights selected by minimizing a penalized local criterion. This allows the relative importance of different models to adaptively evolve over time in response to structural shifts. We establish an asymptotic optimality for the proposed TVMA approach in achieving the lowest possible quadratic forecast errors. The convergence rate of the selected time-varying weights to the optimal weights minimizing expected quadratic errors is derived. Moreover, we show that when one or more correctly specified models exist, our method consistently assigns full weight to them, and an asymptotic normality for the TVMA estimators under some regularity conditions can be established. Furthermore, the proposed approach encompasses special cases including time-varying VAR models with exogenous predictors, as well as time-varying factor augmented VAR (FAVAR) models. Simulations and empirical applications illustrate the proposed TVMA method outperforms some commonly used model averaging and selection methods in the presence of structural changes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的时变模型平均（TVMA）方法，旨在提升面临结构变化的多变量时间序列预测准确性。TVMA方法通过最小化惩罚局部准则选取最优时变组合权重，对一组时变向量自回归模型的预测结果进行平均。这使得不同模型的相对重要性能够随时间自适应调整，以应对结构转变。我们为所提出的TVMA方法建立了渐近最优性，确保其达到最低可能的二次预测误差。同时，推导了所选时变权重向最小化期望二次误差的最优权重收敛的速度。此外，我们证明，在存在一个或多个正确设定模型的情况下，该方法能一致地将全部权重赋予这些模型，并在一定正则条件下，可建立TVMA估计量的渐近正态性。进一步地，所提方法涵盖了特殊情形，包括含外生预测变量的时变VAR模型，以及时变因子增强VAR（FAVAR）模型。模拟与实证应用表明，在结构变化存在时，所提出的TVMA方法优于一些常用的模型平均与选择方法。

title: The Economics of Age at School Entry: Insights from Evidence and Methods
title_zh: 入学年龄的经济学：来自证据与方法的洞见
title_primary: 入学年龄的经济学：来自证据与方法的洞见
title_secondary: The Economics of Age at School Entry: Insights from Evidence and Methods
authors: Cavallo, Mariagrazia, Dhuey, Elizabeth, Fumarco, Luca, Halewyck, Levi, ter Meulen, Simon
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article reviews the growing literature on age at school entry and its effects over the life course. Age at school entry affects a broad range of outcomes, including education, labor-market performance, health, social relationships, and family formation. We synthesize the evidence using a conceptual framework that distinguishes four empirically intertwined components of age at school entry: starting age, age at outcome, relative age, and time in school. Within this framework, we highlight six key channels through which age at school entry operates. While the effects of age at school entry are often substantial and persistent, many studies estimate bundled impacts without isolating specific components or directly measuring underlying mechanisms. We explain how different research designs capture distinct combinations of these components. We also highlight how institutional heterogeneity and behavioral responses can complicate the interpretation of results. We conclude by outlining directions for future research and policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了关于入学年龄及其对生命历程影响的日益增长的文献。入学年龄影响广泛的结果，包括教育、劳动力市场表现、健康、社会关系及家庭形成。我们通过一个概念框架综合现有证据，该框架区分了入学年龄的四个经验上相互交织的组成部分：起始年龄、结果测量时的年龄、相对年龄及在校时间。在此框架内，我们重点阐述了入学年龄发挥作用的六个关键渠道。尽管入学年龄的影响通常显著且持久，但许多研究估计的是捆绑效应，而未分离具体组成部分或直接测量潜在机制。我们解释了不同研究设计如何捕捉这些组成部分的不同组合，并强调了制度异质性与行为反应如何使结果解读复杂化。最后，我们概述了未来研究与政策设计的方向。

title: Investing in Mothers? The Long-Run Impact of a Universal Child Care Program on Maternal Work and Income
title_zh: 投资于母亲？一项普及儿童保育计划对母亲工作与收入的长期影响
title_primary: 投资于母亲？一项普及儿童保育计划对母亲工作与收入的长期影响
title_secondary: Investing in Mothers? The Long-Run Impact of a Universal Child Care Program on Maternal Work and Income
authors: Michael Baker, Jonathan Gruber, Kevin S. Milligan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide new estimates of the effects of universal child care on the long-term labor outcomes of mothers, documenting the life-cycle impact of Quebec’s universal, subsidized child care program on maternal labor supply, earnings, social program benefit receipt and tax remittances. We find an enduring positive impact on mothers’ employment long after children have aged out of the preschool years. There is also a long-run impact on earnings which grows to be twice as large as the participation effect. This arises because of growth in the intensity of labor force participation and a rise in hourly wages over time, suggesting that initial investments in work have multiplier effects later in women’s careers. There is clear evidence of occupational upgrading but most of the growth is within occupation, including the impact of more labor market experience in the years after children are out of child care. We show that, as a result, tax remittances grow over the lifecycle, and social assistance and employment insurance receipts fall. Our estimate of the fiscal balance of these effects reveals that the net present value of the flow of fiscal benefits may recapture between 75 and 117 percent of the upfront costs of the program.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于普及型儿童保育对母亲长期劳动成果影响的新估计，记录了魁北克省普及型、补贴性儿童保育项目对母亲劳动力供给、收入、社会福利项目领取及税收缴纳的整个生命周期影响。研究发现，即使在子女度过学龄前阶段多年后，该项目对母亲就业仍存在持久的积极影响。此外，对收入的长期影响规模达到参与效应的两倍。这一现象源于劳动力参与强度的增长以及小时工资随时间推移的提升，表明早期工作投入在女性职业生涯后期产生了乘数效应。有明确证据显示职业晋升现象，但大部分增长发生在职业内部，包括子女脱离保育后多年积累的劳动力市场经验的影响。我们证明，由此产生的税收缴纳在整个生命周期中持续增长，而社会救助和失业保险领取金额则下降。基于这些效应的财政平衡估算表明，财政收益流的净现值可能回收该项目前期成本的75%至117%。

title: Job Sorting and the Labor Market Effects of a Criminal Record
title_zh: 犯罪记录的职业分类与劳动力市场效应
title_primary: 犯罪记录的职业分类与劳动力市场效应
title_secondary: Job Sorting and the Labor Market Effects of a Criminal Record
authors: Randi Hjalmarsson, Louis-Pierre Lepage, Matthew Lindquist, Conrad Miller, William Parker 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the effects of a criminal record on labor market outcomes and the mediating role of job sorting using Swedish register data. Prime-age adults with criminal records earn about 30% less than observably similar adults without records and are concentrated in specific employers and occupations. To estimate the causal effect of a criminal record, we use an event study design that compares outcomes for adults charged with an offense for the first time to matched adults who were suspected of a similar offense but not charged. Acquiring a criminal record reduces months employed by 2% and annual earnings by 5%. These negative effects are: twice as large for more serious or subsequent charges, not driven by job displacement or incapacitation, and not mitigated by automatic record expungement, which typically occurs 5 or 10 years after case disposition. We classify firms by their propensity to hire workers with criminal records, holding suspected offense history fixed. A criminal record reduces employment at firms classified as less likely to hire workers with criminal records, increases employment at other firms, and decreases monthly wages across all firm types. Firm propensity to hire workers with criminal records varies substantially — even within industries — and is linked to firm size and managers’ prior exposure to people with records. Leveraging manager moves across small firms, we find that when a firm hires a new manager with greater prior exposure to people with criminal records, it hires more people with records, with no detectable effect on productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用瑞典登记数据，考察犯罪记录对劳动力市场结果的影响以及工作分类的中介作用。有犯罪记录的壮年成年人收入比观察特征相似的无记录成年人低约30%，且集中于特定雇主和职业。为估计犯罪记录的因果效应，我们采用事件研究设计，将首次被指控犯罪的成年人与匹配的因类似罪行被怀疑但未被指控的成年人进行结果比较。获得犯罪记录会使就业月数减少2%，年收入减少5%。这些负面效应在更严重或后续指控中扩大两倍，并非由工作替代或失能效应驱动，且无法通过通常在案件结案后5年或10年自动执行的记录消除政策缓解。我们根据企业雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的倾向性对企业进行分类，同时固定被怀疑的犯罪史。犯罪记录会降低在分类为不太可能雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的企业的就业率，增加在其他企业的就业率，并降低所有类型企业的月工资。企业雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的倾向性差异显著——即使在行业内部——且与企业规模及管理者此前接触有犯罪记录者的经历相关。利用管理者在小企业间的流动，我们发现当企业雇佣一位此前接触有犯罪记录者经历更丰富的新管理者时，会雇佣更多有犯罪记录者，且对生产率无显著影响。

abstract: This paper explores the relationship between the myopia, the solvency and the reputation of a government choosing the optimal financing policy given a particular path of government spending. A central result is the demonstration of a logical link between government myopia and insolvency in the sense that there is a class of models for which a solution to the optimal taxation problem does not exist. Results are shown analytically for a very simple non-monetary economy, for a seigniorage model examined by Obstfeld and, using simulations, for a more developed non-Ricardian model with capital.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在给定政府支出路径下，政府选择最优融资政策时，其短视性、偿付能力与声誉之间的关系。核心结论在于揭示了政府短视与偿付能力之间的逻辑关联——存在一类模型，其中最优税收问题的解不存在。研究通过解析方法分析了一个极为简单的非货币经济体，针对奥布斯菲尔德所研究的铸币税模型进行了探讨，并利用模拟方法对包含资本的更发达的非李嘉图模型进行了分析。

title: In Sickness and in Health: Retirement Responses to Spousal Health Shocks
title_zh: 疾病与健康：配偶健康冲击对退休决策的影响
title_primary: 疾病与健康：配偶健康冲击对退休决策的影响
title_secondary: In Sickness and in Health: Retirement Responses to Spousal Health Shocks
authors: Hyeran Chung, Haena Lee, Sita Slavov
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Health shocks are a major driver of retirement. However, the existing literature on this topic tends not to consider the marital context in which retirements occur. Using the 1992-2022 Health and Retirement Study and staggered difference-in-differences methods, we investigate how spousal health shocks impact retirement transitions. We also investigate whether these effects differ by gender and health insurance status. We consider multiple definitions of health shocks, including self-reported health declines, additional diagnoses, hospitalizations, increases in out-of-pocket medical spending, and functional deterioration. Our results suggest that the probability of retirement increases by 1.2 to 1.3 percentage points (12 to 13 percent) after a spouse’s new health condition diagnosis or hospitalization. These retirements tend to occur earlier than anticipated. They also tend to be concentrated among women and respondents with employment-based health plans that include retiree coverage for their spouse.
abstract_zh: 健康冲击是退休的主要驱动因素之一。然而，现有相关文献往往未考虑退休发生的婚姻背景。利用1992-2022年健康与退休研究数据及交错双重差分法，我们探究配偶健康冲击如何影响退休转变，并分析这些效应是否因性别和医疗保险状况而异。我们采用多种健康冲击定义，包括自评健康下降、新增诊断、住院治疗、自付医疗支出增加及功能退化。结果表明，配偶新诊断健康问题或住院后，个体退休概率上升1.2至1.3个百分点（12%至13%）。这些退休往往早于预期，且主要集中在女性及拥有包含配偶退休后医疗保险的就业型健康计划的受访者中。

title: The Role of College Education in the Rise of ``New Work": Measurement and Evidence
title_zh: 大学教育在“新工作”兴起中的作用：测度与证据

authors: Gueyon Kim, Cassandra Merritt, Giovanni Peri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a novel semantic-distance-based algorithm and apply it to job titles data to identify ``new work''---new types of jobs introduced in a labor market. Implementing these measures for the US (1980-2010), we show that the share of college-educated workers across occupations and locations is the strongest predictor of new work, even after controlling for technological change, trade, immigration, population aging, and agglomeration economies. Using pre-1920 land-grant colleges as instruments in matched treatment-control analyses, we find evidence consistent with a strong, positive causal effect of college-educated density on ``new work" creation. Complementary analysis based on Lightcast online vacancy data (2017-2022) confirms this pattern.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于语义距离的新算法，并将其应用于职位名称数据，以识别“新工作”——即劳动力市场中引入的新型职业类型。通过在美国（1980-2010年）实施这些度量，我们发现，即使在控制了技术变革、贸易、移民、人口老龄化和集聚经济等因素后，各职业和地区中受过大学教育的劳动者占比仍是新工作出现的最强预测因子。利用1920年前赠地学院作为工具变量，在匹配处理-对照分析中，我们发现了与大学教育密度对新工作创造具有强烈正向因果效应相一致的证据。基于Lightcast在线职位空缺数据（2017-2022年）的补充分析进一步证实了这一模式。

title: The Hospital Desegregation Campaign and Black Postneonatal Mortality in the Deep South
title_zh: 南方医院废除种族隔离运动与黑人新生儿后期死亡率
title_primary: 南方医院废除种族隔离运动与黑人新生儿后期死亡率

authors: D. Mark Anderson, K. Charles, D. Rees
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend toward in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of antidiscrimination policies imposed on reluctant actors.
abstract_zh: 1966年，美国南方医院被禁止参与联邦医疗保险计划，除非其终止长期实行的种族隔离做法。利用五个深南部州的数据，并借助县级层面联邦医疗保险认证时间的差异，我们发现，获得表面整合的医院对黑人新生儿后期死亡率并无影响。同样，几乎没有证据表明这场运动促进了南方黑人母亲在医院分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院废除种族隔离运动描述为仅带来表面变化的说法一致，并揭示了强加于不情愿行为者的反歧视政策的局限性。

abstract: China's miraculous development has faced major challenges in recent years, partly triggered by the U.S.-China trade war that started in 2018. This paper provides a systematic evaluation of the detrimental consequences of the trade war over the period from 2018:Q1 to 2021:Q1 for China's final demands and industrial outputs as well as for Chinese consumers' and importers' welfare. We construct a Leontief input-output framework with isoelastic demands and complete tariff pass-through, and adopt Harberger's triangle approach to deadweight loss based on partial leakage of tariff revenues. We find that ICT, Furniture, Food, Primary, and Electrical were the most negatively affected sectors in terms of final demand changes, and that the negative impacts on sectoral outputs were largest in ICT and Auto. Our results indicate that Primary, Food, Paper, Petroleum, Chemicals, and ICT incurred the biggest deadweight losses over the entire tariff change, and that Primary, Food, Chemicals, ICT, and Machinery suffer large total losses with 20% tariff leakages. Primary was hurt the most in both measures. China's aggregate total loss amounted to US$1.57 billion, approximately 0.0089% of China's gross output. While the trade war led to a lose-lose outcome, China's aggregate total loss as a percentage of gross output is less than one-fifth of the counterpart in the U.S. Our main findings
abstract_zh: 中国近年来的奇迹般发展面临重大挑战，部分起因于2018年开始的中美贸易战。本文系统评估了2018年第一季度至2021年第一季度期间贸易战对中国最终需求、产业产出以及中国消费者和进口商福利的不利影响。我们构建了一个具有等弹性需求和完全关税传导的列昂惕夫投入产出框架，并采用哈伯格三角形方法，基于关税收入的部分漏损来计算无谓损失。研究发现，信息通信技术、家具、食品、初级产品及电气行业在最终需求变化方面受负面影响最为严重，而部门产出所受负面影响在信息通信技术和汽车行业最大。我们的结果表明，在整个关税变动期间，初级产品、食品、造纸、石油、化学品和信息通信技术行业遭受了最大的无谓损失，而在20%关税漏损情况下，初级产品、食品、化学品、信息通信技术和机械行业承受了较大的总损失。初级产品行业在这两项指标中受损最为严重。中国的总损失合计达15.7亿美元，约占中国总产出的0.0089%。尽管贸易战导致了双输的结果，但中国总损失占产出的比例不足美国对应比例的五分之一。我们的主要发现

title: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
title_zh: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应
title_primary: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应
title_secondary: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
authors: Tobias Eibinger, Sachintha Fernando
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO 2 and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO x . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。

title: Plastic Dumping Grounds: The International Incidence of Environmental Regulation
title_zh: 塑料倾倒场：环境规制的国际影响
title_primary: 塑料倾倒场：环境规制的国际影响
title_secondary: Plastic Dumping Grounds: The International Incidence of Environmental Regulation
authors: Banu Demir, Swati Dhingra
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Environmental regulations often generate environmental improvements at home, yet their consequences may extend far beyond the countries that adopt them. The international incidence of environmental regulation remains poorly understood. We study where the resulting environmental damages emerge and who ultimately bears their costs using China's 2017 ban on waste imports, which triggered a large reallocation of global recycling activity. Combining international trade data, administrative records, direct measures of firms' waste mismanagement, and local pollution data in the main destination for diverted waste, we examine the international incidence of environmental regulation by tracing the rarely observed process linking trade reallocation to firm behavior, pollution exposure, and welfare. The ban increased pollution-intensive plastic waste imports, lowering input costs for downstream firms using recyclable materials. Meanwhile, imported waste displaced domestic recyclables, leading firms to adopt harmful disposal methods. The environmental damages from air pollution exceeded the economic gains from access to lower-cost inputs.
abstract_zh: 环境法规往往能改善本国环境质量，但其影响可能远超实施国边界。目前学界对跨国环境规制效应的理解仍十分有限。本文以中国2017年实施的废品进口禁令为研究对象——该政策引发了全球回收活动的重大重组——探究由此产生的环境损害发生在何处，以及最终由谁承担其成本。通过整合国际贸易数据、行政记录、企业废弃物管理不当的直接测度指标，以及废弃物转移主要目的地的局部污染数据，我们追踪了从贸易重组到企业行为、污染暴露及福利效应的罕见传导链条，从而考察环境规制的跨国影响。研究发现：该禁令增加了污染密集型塑料废品的进口，降低了使用可回收材料的下游企业的投入成本；与此同时，进口废品挤占了国内可回收物市场，导致企业采用有害处置方式。空气污染造成的环境损害已超过低成本投入带来的经济收益。

title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
title_zh: 在门槛处：中等收入陷阱日益凸显的相关性

authors: Patrick A. Imam, Jonathan R. W. Temple
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.
abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。

title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice

authors: Pedro Bordalo, Nicola Gennaioli, Giacomo Lanzani, Andrei Shleifer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause re-categorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的关注取决于其将当前问题归类于过去解决过的一组问题中的方式。分类过程依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征及情境特征。该模型表明，在给定问题中，基于不同的过往经历会产生注意力与选择的异质性；而当无关情境的变化引发重新分类时，则会导致不稳定性。我们证明，选择问题表征的异质性与不稳定性统一了判断与决策中的主要偏差。

authors: Chao Gu, Randall Wright, Yu Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Following Sargent and Wallace’s ‘Some Unpleasant Monetarist Arithmetic,’ we study different ways to implement monetary and fiscal policy. In one case, monetary policy pegs the path of the money supply, while fiscal policy adjusts endogenously to balance the budget. In another, fiscal policy pegs the deficit path, while money adjusts to balance the budget. We ask which is more prone to instability – i.e., more likely to have multiple equilibria, endogenous dynamics, or volatile responses to news? The answer depends on whether inflation (equivalently, the deficit) is positive or negative in the long run. This is consistent with cross-country data.
abstract_zh: 遵循萨金特和华莱士的《令人不快的货币主义算术》，我们研究了货币与财政政策的不同实施方式。一种情形下，货币政策锚定货币供给路径，财政政策内生调整以实现预算平衡；另一种情形下，财政政策锚定赤字路径，货币供给则通过调整实现预算平衡。我们探究哪种政策组合更易引发不稳定性——即更可能产生多重均衡、内生动态或对新闻的剧烈反应？答案取决于长期通胀（等价于赤字）为正还是为负。这一结论与跨国数据相吻合。

title: Smallholders’ willingness to pay for information: A comparison of individual purchase decisions with contributions to a club good. Evidence from Indonesian rice farmers
title_zh: 小农户对信息的支付意愿：个体购买决策与俱乐部物品贡献的比较——来自印度尼西亚稻农的证据

authors: Michael Grimm, Nathalie Luck, Alia Bihrajihant Raya, Udit Sawhney
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Soil tests provide information that can help farmers optimize their inputs. This can reduce costs, increase yields and profits, and contribute to sustainable soil health. Yet soil tests are rarely used by small-scale farmers and are typically not offered by extension workers. Instead, high hopes are pinned on a market-based dissemination. In this study, we elicit small-scale farmers’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for rapid, low-cost soil tests using incentive-compatible auctions. Additionally, we test whether randomized participation in a sustainable soil management training can increase farmers’ WTP. Furthermore, we elicit WTP in an alternative setting by measuring the willingness to contribute to the costs of a soil test kit when entire farmer groups are offered kits containing 50 tests. The average WTP for soil tests amounts to 39% of the market price and is not statistically different if soil tests are offered to groups where free riding is possible. Participants who were exposed to prior training do not exhibit a higher WTP per test. Data collected five months after the WTP experiment indicate an association between soil testing and reduced use of inorganic fertilizers—particularly nitrogen—as well as more sustainable input management in the context characterized by prevalent overuse. Our results can guide the integration of subsidized soil tests into extension programs.
abstract_zh: 土壤测试能提供有助于农户优化投入品的信息，从而降低成本、提高产量和利润，并促进土壤健康的可持续发展。然而，小农户很少使用土壤测试，推广人员通常也不提供此项服务。相反，人们寄厚望于基于市场的推广方式。本研究通过激励相容的拍卖方式，测度小农户对快速、低成本土壤测试的支付意愿（WTP）。此外，我们检验了随机参与可持续土壤管理培训是否能提高农户的支付意愿。进一步地，我们在另一种情境下测度支付意愿，即当整个农户群体获得包含50次测试的土壤测试套件时，衡量其为该套件成本分担的意愿。结果显示，土壤测试的平均支付意愿为市场价格的39%，且在允许搭便车行为的群体情境下，支付意愿在统计上无显著差异。接受过先前培训的参与者并未表现出更高的单次测试支付意愿。在支付意愿实验五个月后收集的数据表明，土壤测试与无机肥料（尤其是氮肥）使用减少之间存在关联，并在普遍存在过度使用的背景下，促进了更可持续的投入品管理。我们的研究结果可为将补贴性土壤测试纳入推广计划提供指导。

title: Ben Bernanke and Bagehot's Rules: Further Explorations
title_zh: 本·伯南克与白芝浩规则：进一步探索

title_secondary: Ben Bernanke and Bagehot's Rules: Further Explorations
authors: EMMANUEL CARRÉ, LAURENT LE MAUX
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-12-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In an article published in this journal, Hogan, Le, and Salter (2015) challenge Bernanke's claim, according to which the Federal Reserve's policy was consistent with Bagehot's rules of lending of last resort during the 2007–09 financial crisis. The purpose of our paper is twofold. First, we comment on the article by Hogan, Le, and Salter entitled “Ben Bernanke and Bagehot's rules,” which mainly focuses on the Federal Reserve's policy but does not fully investigate Bernanke's theory of lending of last resort. Second, we provide a more detailed exploration of Bernanke's approach to Bagehot's rules, and especially the rule of a high rate. We examine how Bernanke attempts to adapt Bagehot's rules to the modern monetary and financial system and how he addresses the theoretical arguments centered on moral hazard. We conclude that the rule of lending of last resort, as suggested by Bernanke, is plainly not in accordance with his previous analysis about financial stability policy.
abstract_zh: 在本刊发表的一篇文章中，Hogan、Le和Salter（2015）对伯南克的主张提出了质疑，该主张认为美联储在2007-09年金融危机期间的政策符合巴杰特最后贷款人规则。本文的目的有两个方面。首先，我们对Hogan、Le和Salter题为“本·伯南克与巴杰特规则”的文章进行评论，该文主要聚焦于美联储的政策，但未充分探讨伯南克的最后贷款人理论。其次，我们更详细地探究了伯南克对巴杰特规则的处理方式，尤其是高利率规则。我们考察了伯南克如何试图将巴杰特规则适应现代货币金融体系，以及他如何应对围绕道德风险的理论争论。我们得出结论，伯南克所提出的最后贷款人规则，显然与他先前关于金融稳定政策的分析并不一致。

title: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: COVID-19疫情后大型贝叶斯向量自回归模型的贝叶斯模型比较
title_primary: COVID-19疫情后大型贝叶斯向量自回归模型的贝叶斯模型比较
title_secondary: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
authors: Joshua C.C. Chan, Xuewen Yu, Wei Zhang
official: 官方在线 2025-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: There is an increasing interest in applying variational Bayes techniques to estimating large Bayesian vector autoregressions (VARs) with stochastic volatility. However, less attention has been paid to the development of appropriate tools for comparing these high-dimensional models, especially among those designed to address COVID-19 outliers. This paper develops a marginal likelihood estimator that combines importance sampling and variational approximation for comparing large VARs with different time-varying volatility specifications and outlier adjustments. Through a Monte Carlo study, we show that the proposed approach is fast and able to identify the correct models. The effectiveness of the proposed method is further illustrated through an empirical application of comparing a variety of 180-variable VARs.
abstract_zh: 将变分贝叶斯技术应用于估计具有随机波动性的大规模贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）模型，正引起越来越多的关注。然而，对于开发适当的工具来比较这些高维模型，尤其是那些旨在处理COVID-19异常值的模型，关注相对较少。本文提出了一种边际似然估计器，结合重要性抽样与变分近似，用于比较具有不同时变波动性设定和异常值调整的大规模VAR模型。通过蒙特卡洛研究，我们展示了所提方法快速且能够识别正确模型。所提方法的有效性进一步通过一个包含180个变量的多种VAR模型比较的实证应用得到验证。
